name: Amazon EC2
line: Rent virtual machines and manage their operating systems and apps.

free.text: Up to $200 in credits; new account access ends by six months

work.math: 730 hours at $0.0104 an hour, plus 730 hours at $0.005 an hour for a public IP address, plus 20 GB of disk at $0.08 per GB a month, plus $0 for eligible data sent out = $12.842 a month.
Same server, IPv4 address, disk and eligible $0 data sent out: $12.842 a month. Extra CPU credits (charges when CPU use stays above the base level) may add cost.
Compute, the IPv4 address and a 30 GB gp3 disk total $36.564 a month, plus snapshot storage based on actual size.
